description: This file contains ARM assembly implementations of SHA256 hash function routines, including platform-specific optimized paths for ARMv4, ARMv7, and ARMv8 with NEON support. It defines constants, platform detection, and multiple optimized functions for processing SHA256 blocks, including NEON-accelerated versions.

methods.name: sha256_block_data_order
methods.description: Main assembly implementation of SHA256 block processing for ARMv7 and earlier platforms.

methods.name: sha256_block_data_order_neon
methods.description: NEON-accelerated implementation of SHA256 block processing for ARMv7+ with NEON support.

methods.name: sha256_block_data_order_armv8
methods.description: ARMv8 optimized implementation of SHA256 block processing using ARMv8 instructions.
